nearestCenter.warning: A nearest centre is not proof that the query point is inside an administrative area.

pointInPolygon.index: feature bounding-box prefilter plus ray casting
pointInPolygon.warning: Türkiye boundaries are for administrative visualization and spatial lookup, not cadastral or legal use.

edgeCases.boundary: Points on a ring return boundary-or-overlap confidence.
edgeCases.islands: MultiPolygon parts are evaluated independently; nearest-centre results may be far from small islands.
edgeCases.holes: Interior rings are excluded; a point on a hole ring is reported as boundary.
edgeCases.disputedAreas: All matching features are returned without choosing or asserting sovereignty.
edgeCases.openWater: Polygon lookup returns no match; nearest-centre may still return a low-confidence result.
